segments.name: Interventional Glaucoma
segments.description: Sells implant-free, minimally invasive glaucoma surgery systems and instruments to ophthalmic surgeons at ambulatory surgery centers and hospital outpatient departments.
segments.evidence: The products for the Interventional Glaucoma segment consist of the OMNI® Surgical System family of products ("OMNI") and the SION® Surgical Instrument ("SION").

segments.name: Interventional Dry Eye
segments.description: Sells wearable open-eye eyelid treatment devices to optometrists and ophthalmologists for meibomian gland evacuation in dry eye disease.
segments.evidence: Our Interventional Dry Eye revenue consists of sales of the TearCare® System ("TearCare"), and related components and accessories.

revenueModel.text: Ambulatory surgery centers, hospital outpatient departments and eyecare practices pay for the devices, which are used in procedures then billed to Medicare and private payors.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our Interventional Glaucoma products primarily to ASCs and HOPDs, who in turn bill various third-party payors, such as Medicare and private health insurance plans for the healthcare services and resources rendered to treat a patient.

changes.text: The two operating segments were renamed in 2025 from Surgical Glaucoma and Dry Eye to Interventional Glaucoma and Interventional Dry Eye.
changes.evidence: The Company's operating segments, which were renamed in 2025, and which also qualify as reportable segments include: (i) Interventional Glaucoma (formerly "Surgical Glaucoma") and (ii) Interventional Dry Eye (formerly "Dry Eye").
